source_story.title: Up to 30x More Work Per Watt: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Sets a New Efficiency Standard for AI Agents

slides.body: AI agents don't chat. They research, execute code, and spawn sub-agents—consuming 15x more tokens than standard chat requests.

slides.headline: CONTEXT IS EATING THE DATA CENTER.
slides.body: In agentic coding and research sessions, context accumulates across every step. Every tool call and sub-agent task becomes input for the next step.
slides.visual_concept: Flow diagram showing context compounding exponentially across agentic sub-tasks.
slides.asset_requirement: Minimal grid diagram showing step-by-step token accumulation.
slides.context: Agentic workflows extend context windows up to hundreds of thousands of input tokens.
slides.implication: Standard GPU clusters waste energy recomputing static context.
slides.swipe_reason: Creates tension around power and cost constraints in AI factories.
slides.psychological_goal: Build technical understanding of why agentic workloads require new architectures.

slides.headline: REAL-WORLD AGENTIC TRAJECTORIES.
slides.body: Using SemiAnalysis AgentX benchmarks on recorded real-world coding sessions, NVIDIA tested DeepSeek V4 Pro under actual context growth and tool execution.

slides.context: GB300 NVL72 delivered 15x higher throughput per megawatt over Hopper on DeepSeek V4 Pro.

slides.headline: 30X THROUGHPUT PER MEGAWATT.
slides.body: The new Vera Rubin NVL72 platform doubles that leap—delivering up to 30x higher throughput per megawatt than GB300 NVL72 on DeepSeek V4 Pro.
slides.visual_concept: Oversized metric container displaying 30x with technical comparison brackets.
slides.asset_requirement: High-contrast lime stat block against ink black background.
slides.context: Vera Rubin NVL72 expands throughput within fixed megawatt power limits.
slides.implication: Power-constrained AI factories can generate 30x more work without extra power.
slides.psychological_goal: Elicit surprise at the magnitude of the efficiency leap.

slides.headline: 35X LOWER TOKEN COST.
slides.body: For power-constrained AI factories, throughput per megawatt determines total revenue—and a 35x reduction in token cost directly unlocks profitable agent scaling.
slides.visual_concept: Pattern interrupt slide with massive typographic emphasis on cost per million tokens.
slides.context: Token cost determines profit margin for serving autonomous agents.
slides.implication: Running continuous, always-on AI agents becomes economically viable at scale.

slides.headline: CODESIGNED FOR LONG CONTEXT.
slides.body: Vera Rubin achieves this via 6th-gen NVLink, NVFP4 quantization, and distributed KV-caching—offloading inactive context to keep GPUs focused on active reasoning.

slides.implication: Single-chip acceleration is dead; full-stack extreme codesign is the new paradigm.
slides.swipe_reason: Explains how the technological feat was engineered.
slides.psychological_goal: Provide complete intellectual understanding of the innovation.

caption:
AI agents don't just chat—they execute, loop, and spawn sub-agents, consuming up to 15x more tokens than standard chat requests. According to new measured benchmark data on real-world coding trajectories (SemiAnalysis AgentX), NVIDIA's new Vera Rubin NVL72 platform delivers up to 30x higher throughput per megawatt and up to 35x lower token costs compared to current GB300 NVL72 systems on DeepSeek V4 Pro.

As AI shifts from prompt-response to autonomous execution, the bottleneck has moved from raw compute to token economics and context handling. Full breakdown in the slides above.
